insight: Irancell gateway's failure-mode flip from DROP to RST after 7 stable passes reveals the TIC/DCI whitelister cluster is actively reconfiguring its TCP handling policy — not a passive infrastructure failure. The simultaneous circumvention tool health (Psiphon 101ms, Tor 463ms, BridgeDB 494ms, Snowflake 473ms ALL UP) confirms circumvention suppression is precision-targeted at specific TLS fingerprints, not blanket anti-censorship blocking. The domestic service stability (Digikala/Aparat ~600ms) suggests prior NIN-path degradation was transient congestion, not policy-driven QoS discrimination. Single-vantage limitation: external probing cannot distinguish between gateway-layer DPI drop vs ISP-edge filtering — TTL-limited tracing or in-country vantage needed for hop-level localization per arXiv 2507.14183.
